pipeline.gate: this contract — semantic checks; grade VALID required

admission_boundary.rule: A VerifiedGraph does not automatically update B. Grade VALID is a necessary but not sufficient condition for topology admission.
admission_boundary.gate: existing CommitAuthority / XulGate commit path in src/kuhul/xul_gate.h
admission_boundary.corollary: Importing a GML file at startup (field_dag.load_gml) populates the in-memory overlay; persisting that to B requires an explicit Xul commit.

V1.name: node_id_required
V1.check: Every node block must contain exactly one 'id' attribute. Zero → MISSING_NODE_ID. Two or more → DUPLICATE_NODE_ID.

V2.name: edge_endpoints_required
V2.check: Every edge block must contain exactly one 'source' and exactly one 'target'. Missing either → MISSING_EDGE_ENDPOINT.

V3.name: edge_endpoints_resolve
V3.check: source(e) and target(e) must be integer IDs that exist in the node table of this graph.

V4.name: overlay_id_unique_within_file
V4.check: Within a single GML file, every node must have a unique integer id. Duplicate integers → OVERLAY_ID_COLLISION_INTRA.
V4.note: Cross-file uniqueness is guaranteed by the file-stem namespace @node:gml:{stem}:{id}. field_dag.cpp:29 enforces this. This check validates the intra-file half.

V5.name: stem_ident_safe
V5.check: The file stem derived from the GML filename (lowercase, non-alnum → '_') must not start with a digit. A filename like '123.gml' produces stem '123', which is not a valid ident. Prepend '_' to produce '_123' to form a valid overlay ID prefix.
V5.note: gml_overlay_id = '@node:gml:' + file_stem + ':' + integer. file_stem is declared as ident in the EBNF. Stems beginning with a digit break the ident production. The validator normalises the stem rather than rejecting the file.

R1.name: verb_wins
R1.formal: verb present ⟹ verb wins; relation attribute ignored
R1.check: When both 'verb' and 'relation' are present on an edge, 'verb' takes precedence. 'relation' is silently dropped. Emit warning BOTH_VERB_AND_RELATION_PRESENT.

R2.name: relation_is_candidate
R2.formal: ¬verb ∧ relation present ⟹ relation becomes RelationCandidate (not VerifiedRelation)
R2.check: When only 'relation' is present, its value feeds infer_relation_from_lexical(). The result is a RelationCandidate, not a VerifiedRelation. Emit RELATION_ALIAS_USED.

R3.name: default_weak_association
R3.check: When neither 'verb' nor 'relation' is present, the edge receives @related_to as weak association default.

R4.name: non_canonical_verb_is_candidate
R4.check: If 'verb' value is not in the canonical set defined in src/micronaut/relation_isa.h, the verb is treated as a string literal passed to infer_relation_from_lexical(). The result is a RelationCandidate, not a VerifiedRelation. Emit INFER_CANDIDATE_USED.

R5.name: near_miss_verb_is_not_canonical
R5.check: A verb that is lexically similar to a canonical verb (e.g. '@relateed_to' ~ '@related_to') is a RelationCandidate with a lower confidence score — it is NOT equivalent to the canonical verb. The validator emits NEAR_MISS_VERB alongside INFER_CANDIDATE_USED. Confidence of the inferred candidate must not be promoted to 1.0.
R5.law: Representation → Relevance → Candidate → Verification, not → Truth

G1.name: coordinates_finite
G1.check: x, y, z must be finite IEEE-754 floats. NaN and Inf are rejected.

G2.name: coordinate_vector_complete
G2.check: If any of x/y/z is present, all three should be present. A partial vector (e.g. only x, y) gets a default of 0.0 for the missing component with a warning.

S1.name: prior_mass_range
S1.check: prior_mass ∈ [0.0, 1.0] when present on a node. It is antecedent prior density only; it does not verify semantic truth.

S2.name: risk_bound_range
S2.check: risk_bound ∈ [0.0, 1.0] when present on a node. It bounds representation risk; it does not authorize topology mutation.

S3.name: loss_cost_range
S3.check: loss_cost ∈ [0.0, 1.0] when present on an edge. High loss restricts VECTOR-µ geometry; it is not a Ch'en proof.

S4.name: inadmissible_vector_rule_flag
S4.formal: risk_bound(n) < loss_cost(e) for incident e => InadmissibleCandidate(e)
S4.check: If an edge loss_cost exceeds both endpoint risk_bound values when those bounds are declared, emit INADMISSIBLE_VECTOR_RULE. This blocks the projection rule from being treated as admissible geometry during startup validation.

D1.name: mutation_enum
D1.check: mutation must be one of insert/delete/modify/unchanged when present on a node or edge.

D2.name: base_version_nonnegative
D2.check: base_version must be a non-negative integer when present on a node.

D3.name: dual_twin_resolves
D3.check: dual_twin must point to an edge id in the same graph when present.

D4.name: dual_twin_reciprocal_warning
D4.check: If edge e declares dual_twin=t and edge t exists but does not point back to e.id, emit DUAL_TWIN_NOT_RECIPROCAL warning.

Q1.name: vertex_boundary_condition_enum
Q1.check: boundary_type must be one of kirchhoff/dirichlet/robin when present on a node.

Q2.name: edge_metric_length_positive
Q2.check: length must be a positive finite number when present on an edge.

Q3.name: refractive_positive
Q3.check: refractive must be a positive finite number when present on an edge.

Q4.name: singularity_enum
Q4.check: singularity must be one of source/sink/saddle/ordinary when present on a node.

Q5.name: velocity_vector_complete
Q5.check: If any of vx/vy/vz is present on an edge, all three should be present. Missing components emit PARTIAL_VELOCITY_VECTOR.

Q6.name: frequency_positive
Q6.check: frequency must be a positive finite number when present on an edge.

Q7.name: text_boundary_enum
Q7.check: text_boundary must be one of sentence/paragraph/article/section/none when present on a node.

Q8.name: continuous_field_projection_only
Q8.check: Quantum graph, plane-wave, flow-field, and text-boundary attributes constrain derived VECTOR-µ/METRIC-µ geometry only; they cannot verify relation truth or commit FoldGraph B.

Q9.name: curve_parameter_finite
Q9.check: parameter_t, t0, and t1 must be finite numbers when present.

Q10.name: arc_length_nonnegative
Q10.check: arc_length must be a nonnegative finite number when present.

Q11.name: curvature_nonnegative
Q11.check: curvature must be a nonnegative finite number when present.

Q12.name: curve_interval_forward
Q12.check: An edge declaring both t0 and t1 must use t1 > t0 for the forward parameterized curve segment.

Q14.name: zero_curl_constraint
Q14.formal: curl(grad f)=0 and partial_i V_j = partial_j V_i
Q14.check: For field_kind=euclidean_gradient, declared curl_x/curl_y/curl_z components must be zero when present.

H1.name: cdata_cso_integrity_enforced
H1.check: When a GML or network manifest provides an inline hardware execution script in kernel_source or shader_source using CDATA, cso_id or @id must equal the SHA-256 content address of the unwrapped code. Missing or mismatched identity fails closed before GPU compilation.

L1.name: semantic_completeness_requires_proof_trace
L1.formal: Sigma models phi => Sigma proves phi
L1.check: A GML item that declares logical_consequence, semantic_entails, models_phi, or sigma_models_phi must also declare a deductive_proof, proof_trace, phase_proof_trace, or sigma_proves_phi. Projection geometry may discover a route, but a supported claim needs a trace.

L2.name: miss_is_not_contradiction
L2.check: MISS records an observation or retrieval deficit. It must not be collapsed into CONTRADICTED unless a separate negative-evidence verdict is supplied outside the MISS state.

L3.name: axiom_extension_must_not_break_laws
L3.check: Non-logical axiom extensions may add domain state only when they do not contradict the primary law layer Lambda from fold_graph.xml and gml.validator.json.

A1.name: signature_isomorphism_preserved
A1.check: When an interpretation algebra (α) maps a structural neighborhood across a phase boundary, the transformation must act as a true functor: preserving the underlying signature edge connectivity and relational rank invariants. Any supplied transformed rank that differs from the substrate rank is inadmissible, protecting the base Fold topology B from algebraic signature corruption.

HE1.name: space_signature_valid
HE1.check: space_signature must be a recognized Minkowski signature when declared. The default runtime event substrate is Minkowski_Minus_Plus_Plus_Plus.

HE2.name: rapidity_nonnegative
HE2.check: rapidity_rho must be a nonnegative finite number. Rapidity is additive progression evidence, not semantic truth.

HE3.name: minkowski_interval_numeric
HE3.check: minkowski_interval must be finite numeric when present.

HE4.name: interval_class_matches_sign
HE4.formal: B<0 => timelike, B=0 => lightlike, B>0 => spacelike
HE4.check: interval_class must match the sign of minkowski_interval unless interval_class is unclassified.

HE5.name: event_vector_interval_consistent
HE5.check: When minkowski_t/x/y/z and minkowski_interval are both present, the stored interval must match the bilinear form under the declared signature. A partial event vector is accepted with PARTIAL_MINKOWSKI_EVENT_VECTOR only when the record makes no dispatch claim; a dispatchable event is rejected under HE8.

HE6.name: hyperbolic_event_projection_only
HE6.check: Hyperbolic event geometry can route or rank candidate continuations only. It cannot claim semantic, topology, verification, or commit authority.

HE7.name: direction_and_distance_valid
HE7.check: direction_x/y/z must be a complete nonzero finite vector when present; hyperbolic_distance must be nonnegative when supplied by a provider. A partial direction is accepted with PARTIAL_HYPERBOLIC_DIRECTION only when the record makes no dispatch claim; a dispatchable event is rejected under HE8.

HE8.name: dispatch_requires_complete_event
HE8.formal: dispatchable(e) => finite(x0..x3) and direction in R^3\{0} and rho>=0 and B(u,u) in R and interval_class and epistemic_state in {SUPPORTED,MISS,UNKNOWN,CONTRADICTED}
HE8.check: An event that claims dispatch (declares event_role, or dispatchable 1/true) is a candidate continuation entering attention/routing, so an incomplete vector, missing interval, missing/zero direction, zero rapidity bound violation, missing interval_class or missing/epistemic-invalid epistemic_state is a DISPATCH REJECTION (HYPERBOLIC_EVENT_INCOMPLETE / EPISTEMIC_STATE_MISSING / EPISTEMIC_STATE_INVALID), never a warning. A record that makes no dispatch claim stays an observation and keeps the partial-field warnings — a warning would otherwise let a half-filled event reach the shader.

LB1.name: boost_rows_finite_and_complete
LB1.check: lorentz_boost row0..row3 must each contain four finite numeric components when the transition is enabled. Missing or malformed rows emit LORENTZ_ROW_INCOMPLETE or LORENTZ_ROW_NOT_NUMERIC.

LB2.name: boost_controls_bounded
LB2.check: lorentz_boost.enabled must be boolean/0/1, alignment_mix must remain in [0,1], and mass_scale must be nonnegative finite. These controls modulate projection geometry only.

LB3.name: identity_when_disabled
LB3.check: When lorentz_boost.enabled is false, row0..row3 must be identity rows within tolerance so a disabled transition cannot silently alter event vectors.

P1.name: profile_projection_not_authority
P1.formal: brain_profile/personality/progression/capability_grams => not semantic_authority and not topology_authority and not commit_authority
P1.check: Profile, personality, progression, and capability gram fields may bias routing or presentation, but they must not claim semantic authority, topology authority, verification authority, or commit authority.

P2.name: profile_metrics_bounded
P2.check: Capability gram scores must be finite values in [0,1], and progression level must be a nonnegative finite number. These metrics are progression signals, not eligibility authority.

T1.name: parameter_generation_nonnegative
T1.check: parameter_generation must be a nonnegative integer when present.

T2.name: training_step_nonnegative
T2.check: training_step must be a nonnegative integer when present.

T3.name: loss_value_nonnegative
T3.check: loss_value must be a nonnegative finite number when present.

T4.name: gradient_norm_nonnegative
T4.check: grad_norm must be a nonnegative finite number when present.

T5.name: learning_rate_positive
T5.check: learning_rate must be a positive finite number when present.

T6.name: gradient_clip_positive
T6.check: gradient_clip must be a positive finite number when present.

T7.name: training_gradient_projection_only
T7.formal: grad_phi L != DeltaF and grad_phi L != DeltaB
T7.check: Training gradients may update provider parameters only; they cannot verify relations or commit FoldGraph topology.

E1.name: local_entropy_nonnegative
E1.check: local_entropy must be a nonnegative finite number when present.

E2.name: entropy_spike_nonnegative
E2.check: entropy_spike must be a nonnegative finite number when present.

E3.name: entropy_bound_positive
E3.check: entropy_bound must be a positive finite number when present.

E4.name: entropy_bound_gate
E4.check: If local_entropy and entropy_bound are both present, local_entropy must not exceed entropy_bound.

E5.name: entropy_gradient_complete
E5.check: If any of eh_x/eh_y/eh_z is present on an edge, all three should be present. Missing components emit PARTIAL_ENTROPY_GRADIENT.

E6.name: entropy_gradient_numeric
E6.check: eh_x/eh_y/eh_z and entropy_delta must be finite numbers when present.

E7.name: diffusion_scale_nonnegative
E7.check: diffusion_beta_inv must be a nonnegative finite number when present.

E8.name: mesh_radii_nonnegative
E8.check: circumradius_R and inradius_r must be nonnegative finite numbers when present on a node.

E9.name: euler_triangle_inequality
E9.check: When circumradius_R and inradius_r are both present and nonzero, the local triangular mesh must satisfy Euler triangle inequality R >= 2r.

TB1.name: tensor_rank_pair
TB1.check: tensor_rank_p and tensor_rank_q must be declared together and both must be nonnegative integers.

TB2.name: smooth_section_flag
TB2.check: is_smooth_section is a 0/1 projection flag. It does not prove C^infinity smoothness; it admits the node to tensor-bundle projection checks.

TB3.name: jacobian_determinant_nonzero
TB3.check: jacobian_determinant must be finite and nonzero when present so coordinate transition is locally invertible.

TB4.name: metric_tensor_components_numeric
TB4.check: g_00/g_01/g_10/g_11 must be numeric when present. Partial metric tensor declarations are accepted with PARTIAL_METRIC_TENSOR warning for lenient parsing.

TB5.name: metric_tensor_symmetric
TB5.check: The local metric tensor is symmetric. If both mixed components are present and differ, emit METRIC_TENSOR_ASYMMETRIC.

TB6.name: metric_tensor_nondegenerate
TB6.check: A fully declared 2x2 local metric tensor must be nondegenerate so it can raise/lower indices and support coordinate transitions.

TB7.name: jacobian_weight_positive
TB7.check: jacobian_w is the positive density/weight factor used by tensor projection providers during coordinate transport.

TB8.name: christoffel_finite
TB8.check: Every christoffel gamma_k_i_j coefficient must be finite numeric when declared. Connection coefficients are geometric diagnostics, not semantic authority.

TB9.name: christoffel_torsion_free
TB9.check: Levi-Civita transport requires lower-index symmetry within the declared tolerance. If gamma_k_i_j and gamma_k_j_i are both present and differ beyond ricci_tolerance, emit CHRISTOFFEL_TORSION_NONZERO.

TB10.name: covariant_rank_increment
TB10.check: covariant_derivative blocks must preserve contravariant rank p and increase covariant rank q by exactly 1. Mismatch emits COVARIANT_RANK_DRIFT.

TB11.name: ricci_identity_residual_bounded
TB11.check: ricci_identity_residual or covariant_derivative.residual must be finite and within ricci_tolerance (default 1e-4). Violations emit RICCI_IDENTITY_VIOLATION.

VerifiedRelation.definition: Canonical verb, exact case-sensitive string match against src/micronaut/relation_isa.h

RelationCandidate.definition: Output of infer_relation_from_lexical() or 'relation' alias. Must pass Ch'en verification before use in B.
RelationCandidate.confidence: < 1.0; assigned by infer_relation_from_lexical() based on lexical similarity
RelationCandidate.path: Candidate → Ch'en → Xul before B update

relation_authority.law: Representation → Relevance → Candidate → Verification — not → Truth
relation_authority.corollary: A near-miss verb is a RelationCandidate with reduced confidence, not a VerifiedRelation with a typo. No silent promotion.

grade.PARSED: Syntactically valid per gml.khanary.ebnf. ParsedGraph produced. No semantic guarantees.
grade.VALID: All FATAL and ERROR checks pass. VerifiedGraph produced. WARNINGs permitted.
grade.ADMITTED: VerifiedGraph accepted into B' via Proposal → Ch'en → XCFE → XulGate. This grade is assigned by the Xul commit path, not by this validator.

id_required_not_in_syntax.observation: node 'id' and edge 'source'/'target' are described as required in comments but not enforced by the EBNF (zero-or-more node_attr).
id_required_not_in_syntax.resolution: Semantic validator checks V1, V2, V3. Grammar remains permissive for ingestion; the validator enforces semantic requirements. No EBNF change needed.

verb_relation_precedence.observation: The 'verb wins over relation' rule is semantic, not in the EBNF.
verb_relation_precedence.resolution: Checks R1, R2 enforce this at the validator layer.

relation_verb_catch_all.observation: relation_verb production includes a string catch-all, so @relateed_to parses cleanly and reaches infer_relation_from_lexical().
relation_verb_catch_all.resolution: Checks R4, R5 classify the result as RelationCandidate with reduced confidence. relation_authority law prevents silent promotion to VerifiedRelation.

file_stem_digit_prefix.observation: file_stem is declared as ident in the EBNF (requires letter or underscore prefix), but the derivation rule allows stems starting with a digit (e.g. filename '123.gml' → stem '123').
file_stem_digit_prefix.resolution: Check V5 normalises the stem by prepending '_' and emits STEM_STARTS_WITH_DIGIT. Overlay IDs remain valid idents after normalisation.

float_1_dot.observation: The float production allows '1.' (digits + dot + zero fractional digits) via zero-or-more { digit }.
float_1_dot.resolution: Accepted as valid. No validator action required. Parser must handle it.

escape_seq_passthrough.observation: Unknown escape sequences (e.g. \q) are passed through literally — the prose is ambiguous about whether the backslash is retained.
escape_seq_passthrough.resolution: Parser-layer concern, not validator-layer. Validator receives parsed string values; the escape handling is completed before validation runs.

decision_theory.theta: authoritative latent semantic state preserved by FoldGraph B
decision_theory.decision_rule: δ(x) maps observed GML/Fold/episode evidence to a derived VECTOR-µ geometry action
decision_theory.loss: L(θ,a) is represented by edge loss_cost or learned risk telemetry
decision_theory.bayes: minimize integrated Bayes risk against prior_mass Λ(θ)
decision_theory.minimax: minimize maximum structural loss; flags INADMISSIBLE_VECTOR_RULE before Ch'en/Xul admission
decision_theory.authority_boundary: Statistical risk constrains projection admissibility only. It cannot verify a relation or commit B.

differential_comparison.authority_boundary: Differential comparison tracks structural drift; XulGate remains the only topology mutation path.

quantum_graph.graph: Metric graph Gamma=(V,E) with each edge e represented by interval [0,L_e].
quantum_graph.authority_boundary: Quantum graph fields are projection geometry only; FoldGraph B and RelationISA remain semantic authority.

plane_wave_field.standing_wave: psi_e(x)=A_e exp(i k_e x)+B_e exp(-i k_e x)
plane_wave_field.authority_boundary: Scattering and resonance supply relevance geometry only.

continuous_vector_field.authority_boundary: Flow fields guide derived trajectories; they do not mutate topology.

structural_boundaries.role: Boundary tokens reset local n-gram context and act as declared field sinks.
structural_boundaries.law: N-gram context may not bleed across article/paragraph/sentence boundaries without an admitted boundary transition.

differentiable_curve.curve: gamma:I->X maps token/gram progression to a derived trajectory over VECTOR-µ geometry.
differentiable_curve.line_integral: DeltaF_curve=int_gamma V(s) dot ds tracks projection displacement only.
differentiable_curve.curvature: kappa(t) marks structural-scale changes such as paragraph inflection and article termination.
differentiable_curve.authority_boundary: A differentiable curve is provider geometry over B; it cannot verify or commit FoldGraph topology.

euclidean_gradient_field.field: V(x)=grad f(x) in flat R^n with g_ij=delta_ij.
euclidean_gradient_field.conservative_integral: int_gamma grad f dot ds = f(gamma(b))-f(gamma(a)).
euclidean_gradient_field.zero_curl: curl(grad f)=0; declared curl components must be zero for certified euclidean_gradient edges.
euclidean_gradient_field.fast_path: Factory may use this flat provider path before Riemannian/quantum providers, because Gamma^k_ij=0.
euclidean_gradient_field.authority_boundary: Euclidean gradient checks validate projection geometry only; Ch'en/Xul remain semantic authority.

training_gradients.parameters: phi denotes provider parameters for VECTOR-µ/METRIC-µ projection geometry.
training_gradients.loss: L_total may combine contrastive, bridge, differential, and risk terms.
training_gradients.gradient: g_phi = grad_phi L_total tunes provider geometry only.
training_gradients.authority_boundary: TrainingGradient != FoldDelta and ParameterUpdate != topology commit; Ch'en/Xul remain semantic authority.

entropy_gradient.gradient: grad H(x)=(dH/dx_1,...,dH/dx_n), stored on GML edges as eh_x/eh_y/eh_z.
entropy_gradient.spike: entropy_spike is a nonnegative structural uncertainty jump used for gating/repair.
entropy_gradient.bound: entropy_bound is an optional maximum admitted entropy; breach emits ENTROPY_BOUND_EXCEEDED.
entropy_gradient.authority_boundary: Entropy gradients shape exploration/repair geometry only; they cannot verify relations or commit B.

free_energy_flow.fokker_planck: partial_t rho = div(rho grad f)+beta^-1 Delta rho.
free_energy_flow.diffusion_scale: diffusion_beta_inv stores beta^-1 and must be nonnegative.
free_energy_flow.authority_boundary: Free-energy flow combines relevance and entropy projection fields; Ch'en/Xul remain semantic authority.

tensor_bundle.authority_boundary: TENSOR-µ learns tensor-bundle projection geometry over B; it cannot verify semantic truth, rewrite RelationISA, or commit topology.

micronaut_attraction.mass_source: Derived from co-occurrence mass M_{Y,X}, governs/tokens neighborhoods, folds, and static_weight; Mass_mu is projection evidence, not fact authority.
micronaut_attraction.anchor: K_mu is the vector_meta/coordinate anchor for the Micronaut attraction basin.
micronaut_attraction.basin: governs/tokens describe the catchment neighborhood; capabilities/sandbox define the execution boundary.
micronaut_attraction.capture_gate: CaptureGate(Q,mu) requires Phi_mu(Q) >= EntropyDiffusion_mu AND policy_ok AND capable AND xcfe_ok.
micronaut_attraction.authority_boundary: Micronaut attraction pulls attention and admits candidates into a sandbox. Ch'en verifies results and Xul is the only persistence/topology commit boundary.

deductive_system.logical_axioms_lambda: Primary runtime laws from fold_graph.xml and gml.validator.json.
deductive_system.nonlogical_axioms_sigma: Verified base topology B and admitted domain relations from GML assets.
deductive_system.rules_of_inference: K'UHUL phase contracts and Micronaut proof traces.
deductive_system.semantic_completeness_boundary: If Sigma models phi inside the current verified context, a deductive proof trace must exist before the claim is exposed as SUPPORTED.
deductive_system.axiomatic_incompleteness_boundary: UNKNOWN and MISS preserve unresolved alternatives; they do not imply phi or not phi.
deductive_system.authority_boundary: TENSOR/METRIC/GPU projections can propose or rank proof routes, but Ch'en verifies and Xul commits.

algebraic_interpretation.authority_boundary: Algebraic folds are interpretation/projection contracts. They preserve structural signature F and cannot mutate Fold topology B without Ch'en, XCFE, and Xul authority.

interval_classes.unclassified: interval not yet classified by Ch'en or projection provider

hyperbolic_key_grammar_event.authority_boundary: Hyperbolic events are future-directed candidate observations. They may guide routing but semantic_authority remains false; Ch'en verifies and Xul commits.

hyperbolic_dispatch.observation_boundary: A record that makes no dispatch claim is an observation: it may carry partial geometry and is reported with PARTIAL_MINKOWSKI_EVENT_VECTOR / PARTIAL_HYPERBOLIC_DIRECTION. The moment it claims dispatch (event_role present, or dispatchable 1/true), every required field becomes mandatory and any gap is a rejection.
hyperbolic_dispatch.runtime_mirror: src/world/vector_projection.cpp admit_hyperbolic_event() enforces the same rule before any record is packed for attention.hlsl; pack_hyperbolic_attention_records_checked() reports the rejects instead of coercing them into the pack.
hyperbolic_dispatch.authority_boundary: Completeness is an admission precondition for projection geometry. It is not verification: Ch'en asserts, XCFE authorizes, Xul commits.
